label: ex:dagger-su2
title: Involutive structure on $\mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}(2))$
html: The representation category \mathbf{C} = \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}(2)) inherits a canonical dagger structure from the antipode. For any equivariant map f \colon V_j \to V_k, its dagger f^{\dagger} is the standard Hilbert-space adjoint, satisfying \langle f^{\dagger}(w), v \rangle_j = \langle w, f(v) \rangle_k. This adjoint remains equivariant because the inner product on each irreducible representation V_j is \mathrm{SU}(2)-invariant. On the algebra A = \mathcal{O}(\mathrm{SU}(2)), the dagger corresponds to complex conjugation composed with inversion: f^{\dagger}(g) = \overline{f(g^{-1})}. Unitarity manifests categorically as the positivity of the composite f^{\dagger} \circ f = \lVert f(1) \rVert^2 > 0 for any non-zero state f \colon \mathbb{C} \to V_j.
